chapter.verse: Zeisu in Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin Jordan gun pan a ciah ciangin, Kha Siangtho in gampa lakah paipih a,
ni sawmli tawntung dawimangpa in a kheem hi. Tua hun sung khempeuh Zeisu in an ne lo a, a ni a cin’ ciangin a gil kial hi.
Dawimangpa in, “Nang in Pasian’ Tapa na hih takpi leh, hih suang khomun suaksak in,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Mite in khomun bek tawh nungta lo hi, ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin dawimangpa in Zeisu paipihto a, leitung gam khempeuh neukha sungin a lak hi.
“Hih vangliatnate leh amau minthan’nate kong pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, kei hong kipia zo a, ka piak nop mi kiangah ka pia thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, hong bia leteh hihte khempeuh nangma aa ahi ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in zong, “Na Topa Pasian na bia ding hi. Ama na bek na sem ding hi, ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin, dawimangpa in Zeisu Jerusalem khuapi sungah paipihin, biakna innpi khum zangah a koih khit ciangin, “Nang in Pasian’ Tapa na hih takpi leh, na pumpi kikiasuk sak in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh: ‘Amah in ama vantungmite nang ading thu a pia ding hi,’ leh
‘Na khe in suang tawh a kisuk khak loh nadingin, Amau in khut tawh nang hong dom ding uh hi,’ ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Na Topa Pasian na ze-et kei in,’ a kici hi,” a ci hi.
Dawimangpa in kheemna a vekpi-in ahih khit ciangin a kiang panin tomkha sung a paikhia hi.
Zeisu in Kha Siangtho’ vangliatna tawh, Galile gamah ciahkik hi. Ama thu a kimkot gam khempeuh ah kizeelin a thang hi.
Amaute kikhopna innah thu hilh a, mi khempeuh in amah a phat uh hi.
A khan’na Nazareth khua-ah Zeisu pai a, ngeina bangin Nipi ni-in kikhopna innah lut a, Lai Siangtho sim dingin a ding hi.
Kamsangpa Isaiah’ Lai Siangtho a kipiak ciangin phen a:

“Topa’ Kha Siangtho in keima tungah a om hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, mizawngte kiangah Lungdamna Thu zasak dingin hong sawl zo hi. A kiman a kikhum mite a kikhah nading ahi zongin, Mittawte in khua a muh kik theih nading ahi zongin, Bawlsiatna a thuak mite khah nading ahi zongin,
Topa’ hehpihna kum ahi, ci-in zaksak nading ahi zongin, Kei hong sawl zo hi,” ci-in kigelhna mun a mu hi.
Lai Siangtho zial a, kikhopna inn nasempa a piak khit ciangin a tu hi. Kikhopna inn sungah a om mi khempeuh in tel takpi-in a en uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Tuni-in hih Lai Siangtho thu in note zak dingin tangtung zo hi,” a ci hi.
Mi khempeuhte in Zeisu thu mang uh a, ama kam sung pan a paikhia lungsim phawn’sakna thu, lamdang a sa uh a, “Hih pa in Josef tapa hilo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Zeisu in, “A tel takpi-in note in, ‘Zatopa aw, nangmahmah na kidamsak in. Kapernaum khua-ah na bawlna khempeuh kote in ka zak bangun, nangma gamah zong bawl in,’ ci-in thugentehna tawh kei kiangah nong ci ding uh hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, kamsang kuamah peuhmah ama gamah mite in a deih kei uh hi.

Ahih hangin ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, Elijah khan’ lai-in kum thum leh kha guk tawntung guahtui kang a, gam sung khempeuh ah kial a tun’ lai takin, Israel mipawlte lakah meigong tampi a om uh hi.
Tua meigong khat beek kiangah Elijah a sawl kei hi. Sidon gam Zarephat khua a, meigong khat kiang bekah a sawl hi.
Kamsang Elisha a khan’ lai takin, Israel mipawlte lakah miphak tampi a om uh hi. Ahih hangin Siriapa Na-aman longal kuamah in damna a ngah kei uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Kikhopna innah a om mi khempeuh in tua a zak uh ciangin, a heh mahmah uh hi.
Amaute ding-in Zeisu khua nawlah a hawlkhiat khit uh ciangin, khua omna mual dawn kui-ah bungbu sawnkhiat dingin a paipih uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu in amaute lai zang pan paikhia-in a pai mang hi.
Zeisu Galile gam Kapernaum khua-ah a paisuk khit ciangin, Nipi ni-in thu a hilh hi.
Amaute in ama thuhilhna lamdang a sa uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amah in ukpa bangin thu a hilh hi.
Tua kikhopna inn sungah kihhuai dawi kha a lut mi khat a om hi.

Amah in, “Nazareth mi Zeisu aw, kote in nang tawh bang kikum i hi hiam? Kote susia dingin hong pai na hi hiam? Nang kua mi na hih ke’n kong thei hi. Pasian’ misiangtho na hi hi,” ci-in aw lianpi tawh a kiko hi.
Zeisu in, “Pau kei in la, ama sung pan paikhia in,” ci-in a taai hi. Dawi in amaute lai zangah amah a puksak khit ciangin, natna bawl loin ama sung pan a paikhia hi.
Mi khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh a, “Hih thu in bang thu ahi hiam? Thu tawh, vangliatna tawh, kihhuai dawite thu a piak ciangin amau a paikhia uh hi,” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Ama thu in a kimkot mun khempeuh ah a thang hi.
Zeisu in kikhopna inn pan a paikhiat khit ciangin Simon’ innah a lut hi. Simon’ sungnu in nakpi-in nattun’ a, a dam nading Zeisu kiangah a thuum uh hi.
Zeisu in ama kiangah ding-in cinatna a taai khit ciangin, a nattun’ dam a, thakhatin thoin zinte a vak hi.
Ni a tum ciangin, cinatna pawlpawl a neite khempeuh Zeisu kiangah hong paipih uh a, amah in amaute khempeuh tungah khut nga-in a damsak hi.
Dawite in zong, “Nang in Pasian’ Tapa na hi hi,” ci-in kikoin mi tampite sung pan a paikhia uh hi. Amah in Khazih ahih lam a theih manun, Amah in amaute taii-in kam khat beek a pausak kei hi.
Khua a vak ciangin Zeisu paikhia a, gampa lakah a pai hi. Mihonpite in zong uh a, a kiang a tun’ uh ciangin, amaute kiang pan a paikhiat loh nadingin a kho nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu in, “Pasian Gam’ Lungdamna Thu khua dangah zong ka hilh ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua bang deihna-in kei hong sawl hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in Galile gam kikhopna innte ah thu hilhin a om hi.
